findings.detail: Description of "xego_request_proof_url" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Private data: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_proof, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Public sink: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_proof, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Destructive: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Private data: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_proof, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Public sink: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_proof, xego_verify_action, xego_check_pairwise_seen_before · Destructive: xego_request_proof_url, xego_verify_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
